6.13.d:
समुद्धृत्य विधानेन त्रिपुण्ड्रं धारयेत्ततः ।
त्रियायुषैस्त्र्यम्बकैश्च मूर्ध्न आरभ्य च क्रमात् ॥
6.13.m: having lifted it according to the rule, he should then apply the tripuṇḍra / in sequence starting from the head, with the [mantras] 'Triyāyuṣa' and 'Tryambaka'.

6.13.s:
tatassadbhaktiyuktena cetasā śiṣyasattamaḥ |
hṛtpaṅkaje samāsīnaṃ dhyāyecchivamumāsakham ||
6.13.d:
ततस्सद्भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा शिष्यसत्तमः ।
हृत्पङ्कजे समासीनं ध्यायेच्छिवमुमासखम् ॥
6.13.m: Then, with a mind endowed with true devotion, the excellent disciple / should meditate on Śiva, Umā's companion, seated in the heart-lotus.

6.13.s:
hastaṃ nidhāya śirasi śiṣyasya sa gururvadet |
trivāraṃ praṇavaṃ dakṣakarṇe ṛṣyādisaṃyutam ||
6.13.d:
हस्तं निधाय शिरसि शिष्यस्य स गुरुर्वदेत् ।
त्रिवारं प्रणवं दक्षकर्णे ऋष्यादिसंयुतम् ॥
6.13.m: Placing his hand on the disciple's head, that guru should speak / the Praṇava into the right ear three times, along with its seer and other details.

6.13.s:
tataḥ kṛtvā ca karuṇāṃ praṇavasyārtha mādiśet |
ṣaḍvidhārtthapari jñānasahitaṃ gurusattamaḥ ||
6.13.d:
ततः कृत्वा च करुणां प्रणवस्यार्थ मादिशेत् ।
षड्विधार्त्थपरि ज्ञानसहितं गुरुसत्तमः ॥
6.13.m: Then, having shown compassion, the excellent guru should impart the meaning of the Praṇava, / together with the thorough knowledge of its sixfold meaning.

6.13.s:
dviṣaṭprakāraṃ sa guruṃ praṇamedbhuvi daṇḍavat |
tadadhīno bhavennityaṃ nānyatkarmma samācaret ||
tadājñayā tataḥ śiṣyo vedāntārthānusārataḥ |
śivajñānaparo bhūyātsaguṇāguṇabhedataḥ ||
6.13.d:
द्विषट्प्रकारं स गुरुं प्रणमेद्भुवि दण्डवत् ।
तदधीनो भवेन्नित्यं नान्यत्कर्म्म समाचरेत् ॥
तदाज्ञया ततः शिष्यो वेदान्तार्थानुसारतः ।
शिवज्ञानपरो भूयात्सगुणागुणभेदतः ॥
6.13.m:
He should prostrate like a staff on the ground to the guru in twelve ways; / he should remain continually subject to him and perform no other action.

Then, by his command, according to the import of the Vedānta, the disciple / should be devoted to the knowledge of Śiva, differentiated as with qualities and without qualities.

6.13.s:
tatastenaiva śiṣyeṇa śravaṇādyaṅgapūrvvakam |
prabhātikādyanuṣṭhānaṃ japānte kārayedguruḥ ||
6.13.d:
ततस्तेनैव शिष्येण श्रवणाद्यङ्गपूर्व्वकम् ।
प्रभातिकाद्यनुष्ठानं जपान्ते कारयेद्गुरुः ॥
6.13.m: Then, through that very disciple, preceded by the limbs such as hearing, / the guru should have him perform the morning and other observances at the end of recitation,

6.13.s:
pūjāṃ ca maṇḍale tasminkailāsaprastarāhvaye |
śivoditena mārgeṇa śiṣyastatraiva pūjayet ||
6.13.d:
पूजां च मण्डले तस्मिन्कैलासप्रस्तराह्वये ।
शिवोदितेन मार्गेण शिष्यस्तत्रैव पूजयेत् ॥
6.13.m: and worship in that maṇḍala called Kailāsaprastara; / according to the path declared by Śiva, the disciple should perform worship right there.

6.13.s:
devannityamaśaktaścetpūjituṃ guruṇā śubham |
sphāṭikaṃ pīṭhikopetaṃ gṛhṇīyālliṅgamaiśvaram ||
6.13.d:
देवन्नित्यमशक्तश्चेत्पूजितुं गुरुणा शुभम् ।
स्फाटिकं पीठिकोपेतं गृह्णीयाल्लिङ्गमैश्वरम् ॥
6.13.m: If he is unable to worship the god daily, he should take from the guru / an auspicious crystal liṅga of Īśvara, endowed with a pedestal.

6.13.s:
varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaśchedanaṃ śiraso'pi me |
na tvanabhyarcya bhuñjīyāṃ bhagavantaṃ trilocanam ||
6.13.d:
वरं प्राणपरित्यागश्छेदनं शिरसोऽपि मे ।
न त्वनभ्यर्च्य भुञ्जीयां भगवन्तं त्रिलोचनम् ॥
6.13.m: 'Better the giving up of my life, or even the severing of my head, / than that I should eat without having worshiped the three-eyed Lord!'

6.13.s:
evantrivāramuccāryya śapathaṃ gurusannidhau |
kuryyāddṛḍhamanāśśiṣyaḥ śivabhaktisamudvahan ||
6.13.d:
एवन्त्रिवारमुच्चार्य्य शपथं गुरुसन्निधौ ।
कुर्य्याद्दृढमनाश्शिष्यः शिवभक्तिसमुद्वहन् ॥
6.13.m: Having spoken this oath three times in the presence of the guru, / carrying firm devotion to Śiva, the disciple should make his resolve steady.

6.13.s:
tata eva mahādevaṃ nityamudyuktamānasaḥ |
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā pañcāvaraṇamārgataḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
6.13.d:
तत एव महादेवं नित्यमुद्युक्तमानसः ।
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या पञ्चावरणमार्गतः ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
6.13.m:
From then on, with a mind ever eager, / he should worship Mahādeva with supreme devotion, according to the path of the five coverings.

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.
